## Core Disciplines & Services
- AI Systems (Autonomous AI agents, RAG, LLM applications, streaming inference, intelligent workflows)
- Software Engineering (Full-stack applications, scalable backend systems, APIs, distributed databases)
- Immersive Web (Three.js, WebGL & OGL fragment shaders, interactive 3D interfaces)
- Product Engineering (Production SaaS, MVPs, internal tools, platforms, product architecture)
- Real-Time Systems (WebSockets, collaboration, live telemetry dashboards, high-frequency state)
